arena: [제어] Double Barrel makes your next Keg Smash deal 50% more damage and stun all targets hit for 3 sec. Lock down an enemy DPS and healer together when they stand close.
[제어] Paralysis incapacitates a target within 20 yds but damage can break it. Use it on the enemy healer your team isn't hitting; Leg Sweep stuns enemies within 6 yds for 3 sec.
[차단] Spear Hand Strike interrupts a cast and locks that school for 5 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[생존기] Fortifying Brew turns your skin to stone for 15 sec, and with Microbrew its cooldown drops by 50%. Use it every time the enemy pops burst cooldowns.

[제어] With Hot Trub, Purifying Brew splits 20% of the purified Stagger damage among nearby enemies, and after purifying damage equal to your max health your next Breath of Fire incapacitates for 4 sec. Stay on melee DPS and use Purifying Brew often.
[위치] Ring of Peace knocks enemies entering the ring out of it for 5 sec. Drop it in the path of melee DPS chasing your healer.
[분담] Tiger's Lust removes all roots and slows from an ally and increases their movement speed by 70% for 6 sec. Use it on your rooted healer or DPS.
bg: [참고] In Battleground Blitz there are 0-1 tanks, and slow tanks need help carrying the flag. With Niuzao's Essence, Roll, Purifying Brew and Fortifying Brew remove all slows so you can keep carrying.

[제어] Ring of Peace knocks back enemies entering the ring, but feared or disoriented targets can't be knocked back. Drop it on the path enemies without CC on them take into a base or toward your flag carrier.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, clear built-up Stagger with Purifying Brew and cut damage taken with Celestial Infusion absorbs.
[제어] Keg Smash with Double Barrel stuns all enemies hit for 3 sec. Use it on enemies grouped to capture a base or on the pack escorting the enemy flag carrier.
[분담] Tiger's Lust removes roots and slows from an ally and makes them 70% faster for 6 sec. Use it on your rooted flag carrier.
